$description: WORMIAN — OXIDE. The charcoal, teal, rust and slate expression; the default edition emitted at :root. Contrast gates live in palette.test.ts.

border-strong.$description: Outlined fields and secondary controls (3:1+ on every surface).

accent.$description: Teal: search emphasis, focus, selected controls, filter state.

accent-ink.$description: Label ink on a solid accent fill.

action.$description: Rust: the main action, active tab underline, navigation indicator.

action-hover.$description: Hover lifts on oxide; the label ink stays charcoal.

action-ink.$description: Label ink on a solid action fill.

structure.$description: Slate: dividers, supporting shapes, secondary outlines.

selected.$description: Tonal fill of the selected result row; pairs with an action-coloured edge.

warning.$description: Amber, not rust: a notice must never read as a routine action.
